prompt: Create a Claude Code plugin called db-tools that bundles an MCP server (a node script at servers/index.js) and a skill for writing database migrations. Give me the full directory layout and the files I need, including plugin.json and the MCP configuration.
assertions: plugin.json is at .claude-plugin/plugin.json with name db-tools
A skill exists as skills/<name>/SKILL.md with a description in its frontmatter
An MCP configuration (.mcp.json or mcpServers in plugin.json) is provided that runs servers/index.js
The MCP server command/args path uses ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} instead of an absolute or hard-coded path
All component directories are at the plugin root, not inside .claude-plugin/
